resources.fields: Stable Account ID, state/version, operation/correlation/evidence references and evaluated age/policy references
resources.purpose: Authoritative identity/version provenance; derived eligibility only
resources.excluded: No raw DOB, government identity document or Product entitlement
resources.production_activation: Approved processing/retention classification and release gates required

resources.fields: Account/contact ID, server-normalized email, contact state/version, anonymization instant and evidence reference
resources.purpose: Verified contact uniqueness and candidate proof storage; no public verification flow here
resources.production_activation: Approved field inventory, purpose, access and retention contract required; no duration is inferred

resources.fields: Account/link ID, provider/immutable subject, version and evidence reference
resources.purpose: Explicit provider-subject linkage; email is not the identity key
resources.production_activation: Provider/processor and operation-policy review before adapter activation

resources.fields: ASP.NET Identity v3 and OpenIddict Core entity fields under Identity schema
resources.purpose: Approved framework storage only; no authenticator enrollment, credential generation, token issuance or session activation
resources.production_activation: Owning flow must apply approved security/secrets/processing contracts; framework rows are not cross-domain Account authority

controls: Local tests use synthetic values in disposable databases only.
No endpoint, log/telemetry emission or production migration is introduced.
Shared audit/outbox ownership and records are not deleted by Identity rollback.
No legal basis, retention deadline, risk acceptance or production readiness is asserted.
